text:
mira: Found a partner archive that contains a KMS-wrapped blob plus a service-account JSON. looks like an onboarding bundle they uploaded to partner-buckets yesterday. tagging eng-security.

audit-bot: Alert: artifact-scan rule=sa-json-or-wrapped fired for object=partner-buckets/onboard/rcv-2026-06-12.tar.gz (hits=1).

oscar: Can you confirm whether the SA is provisioned in prod? if so treat as prod-impact until proven otherwise.

mira: SA claims access to projects/redwood-prod/k8s. treating prod-impact.

paul: Immediate checklist: isolate SA (remove roles), delete keys, block partner IPs if they pulled artifacts, revoke Vault tokens tied to SA, rewrap any ciphertext that used that SA for unwrap, and run audit for token issuance. I'll take keys+RBAC.

sana: I'll own rewrap and audit log forwarding. plan to publish signed manifest once done.

paul: Quick commands if helpful:
```
gcloud iam service-accounts keys list --iam-account=partner-onboard-sa@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com --format=json
# delete keys
for k in $(gcloud iam service-accounts keys list --iam-account=partner-onboard-sa@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com --format='value(name)'); do gcloud iam service-accounts keys delete "$k" --iam-account=partner-onboard-sa@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com || true; done
# strip roles
gcloud projects remove-iam-policy-binding redwood-prod --member=serviceAccount:partner-onboard-sa@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com --role=roles/editor || true
```

oscar: Add a short deny-binding in org policy for that SA so it can't be used during rotation. coordinate with infra for rollout.

sana: Rewrap plan: detect archives that were wrapped with key projects/redwood-kms/wrappingKeys/onboard-wrap and re-encrypt with a new key version. throttle at 5/min to avoid KMS quota. will publish manifest to secure-analytics and share checksums.

mira: Also revoke any Vault tokens that list that SA as a principal. run a token-owner sweep.

audit-bot: Created incident INC-2026-5621 assigned to eng-security. priority=P1.

paul: small Vault commands to revoke tokens by accessor list:
```
vault list auth/token/accessors | xargs -n1 -I{} sh -c 'vault token lookup -accessor {} 2>/dev/null | grep -q partner-onboard-sa && vault token revoke -accessor {} || true'
```

oscar: Add temporary MFA requirement and short TTL for reissued tokens. enforce require_mfa=true on the token role and set max-ttl=1h.

sana: Rewrap started: found 7 archives. rewrap 3/7 done. pushing manifest fragment now.

mira: Partner already paused distribution and provided an IP range for blocking. infra: please apply network block and prevent object reads from that IP set.

infra: Will add conditional deny on the bucket for those IPs and set a short retention for quarantine. done in ~10m.

paul: Post-rotation steps: rotate any KMS keys if they were used for decrypt during builds, force re-issuance of any long-lived credentials minted in last 90d, and add pre-submit scans for partner uploads.

oscar: Forensics: search partner dumps and internal logs for evidence of the SA's usage. grep patterns for private_key and client_email in archives.

mira: After rewrap completes, we will publish signed manifest and provide checksums to partner so they can verify. require they confirm before re-pulling artifacts.

sana: Rewrap complete 7/7. Manifests uploaded to secure-analytics: s3://secure-analytics/rewrap/INC-2026-5621/manifest.json (sha256 checksums included).

paul: Verified checksums and kicked off token revocation cascade. partner confirmed they removed old bundles.

oscar: Follow-ups: 1) update vendor onboarding checklist to forbid SA JSON in bundles, 2) add CI pre-upload image/archive scanning, 3) run a rotation drill next quarter. assign postmortem to mira+sana.

audit-bot: Incident INC-2026-5621 updated: status=contained, owner=mira, sana; last_update=5284001520.

mira: Filing tickets for follow-ups and closing thread here. thanks all. :white_check_mark:
